name: 75766 · Jacksonville, TX
findings: ZIP 75766 (Jacksonville) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75766 (Jacksonville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75766 (Jacksonville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
